question.text: If $\int_{-1}^4 f(x) d x=4$ and $\int_2^4\{3-f(x)\} d x=7$ then the value of $\int_{-1}^2 \mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x}) \mathrm{dx}$

solution.text:
Hints : $\int_{-1}^4 f(x) d x=4$
$$
\begin{aligned}
& 3(4-2)-\int_2^4 f(x) d x=7 \\
& \int_2^4 f(x) d x=-1 \\
& \int_{-1}^2 f(x) d x=\int_{-1}^4 f(x) d x+\int_4^2 f(x) d x=4-\int_2^4 f(x) d x=4-(-1)=5
\end{aligned}
$$
